stations.instrument: Responsa ad proposita dubia, coetus plenarius 21 Martii, 29 Aprilis and 28 Februarii 1986 (Pastor bonus art. 154)

interpretation.answer: Negative to the first part, and with a stated mind. NOTE WHAT HAPPENED TO THIS CANON LATER: Mitis Iudex substituted it entire in 2015, so this interpretation settles the meaning of a text that no longer stands.
interpretation.basis: Read in the Holy See's Latin collection Interpretationes Authenticae, sha256 1e7a0aaa..., at the block headed by this canon; the Dicastery for Legislative Texts serves the same Latin on its own page for this canon and the two were compared and found identical.
interpretation.question: Whether the third head of competence in c. 1673 -- the tribunal of the place where most of the proofs are to be collected -- reaches a case in a certain way; the responsum is `Negative ad primum et ad mentem`, with the mind then stated.

cited.basis: The act decrees that Book VII, Part III, Title I, Chapter I, on cases for declaring the nullity of a marriage, cann. 1671-1691, be substituted ENTIRE from 8 December 2015, and then prints the new chapter. Each of the twenty-one canons is reissued. [Latin delivery, line 68 for the decree and lines 70-124 for the canons.]
